title: Five situations, and the reader saw one
blurb: Four changes went into keeping the silences apart inside the analysis — an outage is not an empty market, a missing engine is not a market with nobody in it — and every one of them arrived at a reader as the same sentence, because the failure type had two values. That sentence tells somebody to name a website, which is right for exactly one of the four: for a search that timed out it sends them to fix something that was never wrong, and for a name several products share it throws away the question they could have answered in a word.
